two escapes occurred in a single run: measurements taken in wrong AWS account and under overly-broad privilege (bedrock:*) were recorded as valid attestations satisfying the current contract

AGENT-tier LLM criterion must then validate declared environment against in-repo IaC anchor, privilege posture against the criterion's scope, and instrument type against authorization claims
new declaration syntax anchors provenance as an indented continuation line under [operator-attested] items in canonical form with em-dash-prefixed justification

criterion ships advisory on first landing pending ADR-0054 corpus-replay calibration; pre-contract [operator-attested] criteria lacking provenance fields are grandfathered with coaching but do not block
